notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26485386/cc9e3159b7cc8f19e81b4eac80bc9d4f779bed69.png[/img]

Hi, I'm Dinaya.

As mentioned earlier, after the failure of The "Hunger Dungeon", both in business and in gaming.

My friends and I parted ways.

And I also resolutely decided to leave the game industry.
Then I lived a stable working life for several years,
Bank savings also slowly and rapidly accumulated from 0 again.


But for some reasons and some consultations from the community,
After thinking hard, I am finally about to enter middle age,
Still decided to quit my job and come back to continue the challenge develop indie games and try to earn money to live.


And as stated in the previous announcement,
Time flies, and after 915 days, I finally finished this "Last Command"

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1487270

I really appreciate the people who have helped me along the way,

Also, thank you to the friends who clicked through this article because you downloaded and played "Hunger Dungeon".



[h3] Now "Last Command" has been officially launched a few days ago. [/h3]
[h3]This is a game that [b]challenges the BOSS with the snake game, and explores the world of programs with an electronic girl[/b]. [/h3]

If you are curious or interested in such game content, please try this work.

And this time I need your help,

Help me click in and see this "Last Command" game.

If it doesn't match your interests, then I will continue to work hard on the next work to try to catch your attention.

But if you are interested and feel good after playing, I hope you can help me share and expose it to people in the community.

[previewyoutube=1g-wFr_2emc;full][/previewyoutube]



[h3]Finally, I want to just take this time,[/h3]

Thank you to the friends who used to chase the mouse to play cheese, the friends who let the mage blow black balls recklessly,

The friends who bombed in the distance with falling thunder, the friends who beat the dragon together, the friends who painted water stains with octopus pirates on the map together,

The little friend who is hiding in ambush and picking up the tail knife, the little friend who hit the treasure chest that hard like a rock.

[h3]"Hunger Dungeon" thank you for playing[/h3]
[previewyoutube=TBTPlmssZTc;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]And I hope you'll enjoy "Last Command"[/h3]

[previewyoutube=0lBWCgtsG-k;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1487270

As long as there is a chance in the future, I will let the IP of "Hunger Dungeon" appear in front of everyone again. I look forward to such a day.

[h3]Thanks for reading by Dinaya[/h3]

Hi guys. I'm Dinaya.
Sorry for my natural language not English.

First, sorry for this news not for Hunger Dungeon.
But I'm back.
[h3] I spent more than year for the new project that the Last Command.[/h3]
[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/BkwNiUICq3z78LFTuL/giphy.gif[/img]

At 2016.
I developed the Hunger Dungeon whit my university classmates.
But the story end is sad. (there has many reason) 

The game download more than one million. But we can't earn enough money to continue.

So we go back to work.

And the years passed.

At 2020.
I quit the job. And come back to develop indie game.
The difference is that this time I’m alone now.
I can't call my friends risk with me that because we are 30 year old.
We are not young anymore.


Although just me come back.
I still has passion for Hunger Dungeon.

I'm really would to remake the Hunger Dungeon.
Maybe like "Hunger Dungeon : Survive", "Hunger Dungeon : Battle Royale" , "Hunger Dungeon : Co-op" or , "Hunger Dungeon 2" and so on.

But I don't have enough money and manpower to do big plan above.
I need step by step. Hoping I can live by develop indie game.

Therefore...
I spent more than year for the new project that the Last Command.

I keeping develop this game where live on Twitch day by day.
Count a day until today. About 322 days have passed.

notes.title: Update 1.15 : For better AI battle.
notes.notes:
Hi,
We adjust AI play style.
Hopping battle with AI will more interesting.

Note: 
We not only adjust for this patch for AI.
And this adjust will continue to next patch or next next !


And another important thing is :
About we removed "in-purchase to unlock hero".
So how to unlock 4 new heros that release after Hunger Dungeon publish?

We will publish independent DLC for that 4 heros.
In the future. ( maybe 1 ~ 2 weeks)

And about some player has been purchase some hero by in-purchase.
So if they want more , they must be buy "Hunger Dungeon Deluxe Edition"
But that is not reasonable for "12 heros+skin price" and you get maybe... just 6 heros and skins. (Because you has been in-purchase some item)

We hoping solve such a situation.
So we plan to publish some DLC.
The content maybe such as 3~4 heros and skins.
So the player can chose more reasonable to unlock heros and skins.

About this plan we can't "accurate" talk you how long to done.
(maybe 1~ 2 month)


Last thing is about Free hero.
We would change this recently.
(Like you guys found free hero is from 4 changes to 3 now.)

And same time, we will protect some player who purchase hero in-purchase. 
 

This time, the issues is so complex!
So I hopping the content is base on Chinese not English (Because my English is bad! I hopping there are not misunderstand.)

Thanks for your reading and support.
We will keeping focus this games.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
大家好，
這一次主要是更新「電腦AI優化」的部份，
而關於這部份的優化，會是持續性的，所以假使這一次的版本中您仍然對於AI有不滿意的地方，可以不用擔心，我們會繼續更新這部份。

而關於上一次改版中，因為移除了英雄的「內購」功能，
導致後續的 4 名新英雄(飢餓地城上架後，所陸續更新新增的英雄)，
目前沒有任何手段可以獲得。

這種情況，我們會在接下來1~2週解決，
我們會以 DLC 的方式提供獲得新英雄的手段。

此外對於過去透過內購，只購買部份英雄的玩家們，
我們也會提供一些途徑，讓玩家可以用「比較合理」的價格，去解鎖剩下的英雄。

例如 : 推出 4 個英雄為一組的DLC，來解決這種狀況。

最後還有一件重要的事情是：關於「免費英雄」的部份，我們也會在這一連串的消費模式調整中，有所改動。但請放心，我們會準備相應的配套措施去彌補那些因為「免費英雄」改動而導致受到影響的內購玩家。

notes.title: Pre-announcement Update - What's to come.
notes.notes:
Hi, Dungeoneers!

It's been a while since our last update. 

The team has been at home enjoying the fun and love over the Lunar New Year holiday so there will be no game update this week. However we would like to announce the next update to give you a rough idea of what is coming up!
 
[list]
[*]"Deathmatch Mode" will be changed to "Classic Mode".
Due to a number of reasons we have decided to change the name of the Deathmatch mode to Classic Mode. There will be several improvements taken to optimize the game experience as well.

[*]New "Deathmatch" mode
A new Deathmatch mode will be introduced. This will be similar to the existing mode but will only be a single 5 minute round, and without the Energy Shard round. The more kills you achieve the more chance you stand in winning. More details will follow later.

[*]Equipment and Spell Scrolls Revamped
We have reviewed lots of the equipment and Spell Scrolls and we have made many improvements on the following:
[i]Therapy Staff, Elven Shelter, Troll Dentures, Laurel, Spell Book, Endless Staff, Holy Ring, Scavenger Hat, Avarice Ring, Greedy Staff, Chicken Leg, Broadest Sword, Colossus Ring, Butcher, Elegant Lance, Raging Lance, Elven Boots, Colossus Belt.[/i]

[*]Balancing
Holy Sister will be buffed (slightly). 

[*]SNew Skin
Samurai's Ronin Skin will be available soon!!
[/list]

Please note: due to time constraints, the above announcements are not guaranteed to be implemented in the next update.

Lastly thank you all very much for your valuable feedback. We will keep our eyes open to all of your future feedback on social media and here on Steam. 

We might not be able to respond to all due to the development we have planned ahead, but we will evaluate carefully whether your suggestion is feasible. 

Thank you :)

Just to let you know we implemented a function to detect those of you who cheated.

notes.title: Update 1.08 version: Payment system update + 500 free Dungeon Doubloons!
notes.notes:
Hi there Dungeoneers!

Today we’re excited to announce version 1.08, which brings with it some exciting changes to the payment system in Hunger Dungeon! As you may have noticed, we introduced “Dungeon Doubloons” in an earlier patch as Hunger Dungeon’s in-game currency. 

We can now let you know that this currency can be used to purchase permanent Hero unlocks and more! We’ve also implemented individual real money purchases, so that players that only want to unlock one or more Heroes or skins can do so. 

Of course, we’re not just focusing on existing items and have created new Spell Scrolls and Equipment- purchasable with Dungeon Doubloons - which you can find in the Store.

In order to thank you for your support, we’ve decided [b]to gift 500 Dungeon Doubloons to each player![/b]

[b]"Note: In order to receive your free Dungeon Doubloons, you need to play a match by joining via the Matchmaking system."[/b]


[h1]Added – In-game Store system[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Permanent Character Unlock
Purchased with real money or Dungeon Doubloons.

    [*]Character Skins
Purchased with real money only. (You must purchase or unlock the Hero before you are able to purchase the alternate skins.)

    [*]Character and skin bundle packs
Sold at a special discount, purchased with real money only. (Ownership of part of the items will not incur a discount).

    [*]Spell Scrolls, Equipment
Available solely in the Store and purchased only with Dungeon Doubloons. (New Spell Scrolls and Equipment will be sold through the in-game Store going forwards)
[/list]

[h1]New Equipment[/h1]
[list]
[*]Cruel Axe
[*]Adept's Magic Gloves
[*]Staff of Hiding
[/list]

[h1]Balance change[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Princess Ranger
Basic Attack Projection Collisions reduced from 0.8 -> 0.6
Trap disappearance time reduced from to 60s -> 42s
Trap confinement effect reduced from 1.75s -> 1.5s


    [*]Goblin Profiteer
Drunken Collision now inflicts the Dizzy effect for 1.2s
Drunk Collision cooldown reduced from 14s -> 12s

[/list]

[h1]Additional[/h1]
A new adventurer will be journeying into the Dungeon sooner than you might realise…

It doesn’t matter how many guides to League of Legends and Dota 2 I read, or how helpful the commentary supposedly is, I can’t fathom what’s happening most of the time when spectating fights in those games. All the wizards are darting about casting swoosh effects and rays of light and an offscreen crowd is screaming and I don’t know who is living or dying.

Hunger Dungeon [Steam page] appeals, then, because I can watch the trailer below and see exactly what is going on. It’s a 1-6 player round-based free-for-all MOBA – which means no teams, no creeps, just brawlin’ – that’s just left early access. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Version 1.050： New connection system patch
notes.notes:
Hi Dungeoneers!

We've just released our new update that includes a new back-end system for match connections!

[h1]Version 1.050[/h1]
Please remember that this is a Beta, and we can't promise there aren't going to be any bugs!

Because we just 4 man , we can test anything about the connection problem (player of the world)

Our new connecting system is by Photon (https://www.photonengine.com)

And if it works...
...all player will be able to connect to each other! :)

With no network setting error :)
No port 7777, firewall, or router settings! :)
AND no host leaving the match and crashing the game! :D

BUT!

The is a slight delay more than the 1.04x version.
We'll make it better but we can't be sure that we can solve the problem.

So...

Thanks for your feedback!
Thanks for your support!

The game will be better than ever!

[h1]Balance[/h1]

Price 200 -> 250
Cost 105/85/85 -> 95
Rate 0.5s -> 1.25s

Price 540 -> 625




[i] The formal English translation later [/i] : (

承上周所述，
因为我们没有足够的人力来确保新连线架构万无一失，

notes.title: Free Heroes for version 1.044: Beast Hero, Samurai, Princess Ranger, Vagrant Ninja
notes.notes:
Free Heroes for version 1.044:
Beast Hero, Samurai, Princess Ranger, Vagrant Ninja 

We made a lot of changes to this week's version to make it more interesting and sustainable for the long term. In the meantime, some functionalities and systems are still under development. We appreciate your patience.

[h1]Samurai[/h1]
We tried to make Samurai players aware when the best time to use [Obsession] is. Therefore, we made some changes to the state of [Obsession] and also increased the damage.  
Changes to [Obsession]:
- Health regeneration increased from 1s to 0.55s
- Damage increased from 3 to 5
- Damage caused by Sword Aura increased from 10 to 13 
- Time decreased from 6.6s to 5s 
- Removed the health penalty
- Hero Value increased from 5 to 10

[h1]Element Fuse[/h1]
We made the following changes because we want Element Fuse players to have a grip on its magic spells rather than just randomly use any of them. Therefore, we made some changes to make some of its skills weaker a little bit. 
- Basic attack cooldown increased from 0.85 to 1.25 
- Damage of [Multi-Robe] increased from 1.3x to 1.2x 
- [Element Explode] cooldown increased from 28s to 34s 
- [Element Explode] Mana recovery reduced from 150 to 100

[h1]Demonic Knight[/h1]
Demonic Knight has been always a really tricky hero to do changes to. So, we tried to stick with its central counter being “Destroy the Holy Relics first then the Hero.” We also did a bit of changes to Holy Relics. 
[b][Grace - Divine Blessing][/b]
- Increased the Healing frequency from 0.35s to 0.7s.
- Damage decreased from 25% to 30%
- Health recovery when attacking increased from 3 to 5 
- Only standing next to Holy Relics will now provide the effects
[b][Grace - The Call][/b]
- Mana consumption decreased from 85 to 50
[b][Holy Summon][/b]
Cooldown decreased from 25s to 18s
[b][Holy Relic][/b]
Health regeneration increased by 3% if no damage is received for 6 seconds
Now transforms into one bottle of wine or one piece of bread upon destruction. (A bottle of wine recovers 15 Health and 50 Mana)

[h1]Princess Ranger[/h1]
Imprison time decreased from 2s to 1.75s

[h1]Equip & Spell Scrolls[/h1]
* Icicle: Decreased the icicle continuous time from 2.5s to 1s
* Explode: Increased the frequency of the damage from 1.5s to 2s
* Defeated: Decreased the damage of each stack from 4 to 3
* Imprison: Decreased imprisoned time from 3.5 seconds to 2 seconds 

[b]* Raging Assault[/b]
Decreased the damage radius from 20 to 16 yards.  
Decreased the damage from 18/24/36 to 18/22/26 

[b]* Flash[/b]
Increased cooldown time from 26/26/18s to 32/32/25s
[b]* Spell Book[/b]
Increased Mana regeneration time from 15/20/30 to 4/8/12 

[h1]Others:[/h1]
* Any Hero with a basic attack lower than 12 will have damage bonus when attacking buildings
* Old Prisoner and Nimble Assassin bots are now not as difficult as before
* The Shop Keeper now can buy back certain Hero's inherent equipment...but we are still in discussion with the Shop Keeper whether to do the same thing to some of the special spell scrolls.

notes.title: Ver 1.0422 – Optimised match connection and fixed some known bugs
notes.notes:
We hot fixed some bugs after 1.0422 release.
Sorry for the inconvenience ~~

----------------------------------

[b][Optimisation][/b]
- Fixed the bug that caused sudden closure of rooms (With the exception of issues caused by room creator)
- Removed the lag caused by Tornado scroll
- Fixed some unclear text displays
- Removed black screen bug

[b][Balance][/b]
- We’ve amended the attack Element Quake
From
Basic attack casts 1 Element Quake which reduces Element Explode cooldown by 1 second. When it hits any creature, it will reduce Element Explode cooldown by an additional 2 seconds.

To
Basic attack casts 1 Element Quake. When it hits any creature, it reduces Element Explode cooldown by 1 second.

- We’ve amended the damage you receive while casting. At the moment while casting some skills you will easily be distracted and terminated. 


[b][Other Changes][/b]
- Holy Relics summoned by the Demonic Knight will be destroyed after every round.

- Removed Boss fights temporarily while improvements are made.
We found that this is not a good idea to have a PvE element (dragon boss) appear suddenly in a PvP environment. Therefore, PvE will be transformed into a new game system shortly. Stay tuned guys!

- Added some information in game to help us collect data about player’s connection environment

[b][Development Report][/b]
Thanks again for the overwhelming amount of feedback and comments.

We are currently fixing known bugs and trying to locate the unknown such as being unable to join rooms (excluding issues from the room creators), disconnection for no reason, problems caused when the room creator leaves the room, exceeding the maximum number of players in a room and etc.Please give us a bit of time and be patient. Thanks. 

By the way, a new rotation of the next round playable characters will be carried out soon. Stay tuned.  

Also some feedback like playing with a controller, mouse double clicks, new match systems, we will keep those in mind and some of these will be actually implemented soon if the development goes well and smoothly.

notes.title: Update 1.041 : Fix most lobby bug.
notes.notes:
Hello Dungeoneers!

Thanks to everyone that provided feedback and comments on our first day in Early Access! We’re happy to report that most of the issues have been amended and that most multiplayer issues have been fixed or at least improved.

* Also, we’ve re-made the Linux 64x 84x versions - please let us know if you have problems playing these again!
We’d just like to summarise some questions that were asked of us so that we can have complete clarity with the community: 

[i]Q: What is the difference between the free-to-play and premium versions?
A: Premium users will have access to all heroes and the premium-exclusive skin. Free-to-play players will have access to 4 heroes a week, on a rotating basis.[/i] 

[i]Q: Can free to play players get locked heroes or skin?
A: Apart from the free characters each week, we don’t have plans to allow heroes to be acquired through game progression.[/i] 

[i]Q: If there are any new heroes in the future will premium players have to purchase again? [/i] 
A: At the moment: probably.

[i]Q: If there is new content in the game, is it going to be free? [/i] 
A: We will judge whether new content should be free and whether it will be fair for all users if it isn’t.

[i]Q: I can’t play with my friends, is it because I am playing the free-to-play version?  [/i] 
A: No, it was a known bug. We have put a filter (filtering by Ping) in our game to filter out players from different regions for example players from Asian territory may not be able to play with those from Europe. Ver 1.041 has been released today where access whether or not to remove the filter.

[i]Q: Any plan to add new content? [/i] 
A: We are currently refining the existing content that will be available on the official release of the game. Before release we will of course keep an eye on all feedback as well as the popularity of the game. (We may not be able to respond to every message but we will keep them all in mind.)

[i]Q: Will there be any other room systems in the future? (For example matching system?) [/i] 
A: We understand the stability is not up to standard we want just yet, and we are currently working on it. We will bear this in mind and hopefully there will be new systems in the future. 

[i]Q: Why are your English responses sometimes a bit strange and sometimes good? [/i] 
A: Sometimes we really want to respond to our beloved English-speaking friends immediately, without going through the proper translation channels. At other times (like this release) we get our English partners to translate and double-check the English.  

Lastly, we aim to browse ALL the feedback and comments you posted in the community, some of them are helpful and some of them are quietly deadly. All we need is time and a little bit of community patience to improve the usability.
We sincerely hope that you have a good time playing Hunger Dungeon with your friends and if you would like to, please support us by purchasing the full game package as this will allow us to keep the support going that much longer. 

PS. It should be fine now for most of you playing with your friends for the Ver 1.041. We cannot guarantee its 100% bug free but as of writing we haven’t found any in our native country of Taiwan. If there are any, please don’t hesitate to post to the community we will fix them ALL!!!!
